listing.name: Veteran Crews 1.0
listing.summary: Reintroduces crew XP and default bonuses for conveniences without generally enhancing in-combat power.
listing.aiSummary: Reintroduces crew XP and default bonuses for conveniences without generally enhancing in-combat power.

description:
Veteran Crews 1.0

Download

Note

: This mod was created purely as a proof-of-concept, I don't intend to continue development on it.

All code free to use, subject to any restrictions that may be imposed by the Starsector license or other mods.

Veteran Crews implements the sometimes-requested reintroduction of crew XP, in a similar way to vanilla's marine XP. It's designed to be easy for users and other mods to add their own XP effects, without needing an IDE.

The default bonuses are chosen to offer a range of conveniences for the player without (generally) enhancing in-combat power.

Have fun and thoughts welcome, even if I won't be acting on them :)
